Provision defines percentage asset-composition test — sums listed qualifying asset categories against total assets and compares to 60% threshold, incomplete without that computation.
result.inputs: total assets at close of taxable year; amounts in each listed category (cash, government/state obligations, certain certificates of deposit, member-secured loans, residential/church real property loans, urban renewal loans, institutional facility loans, defaulted-loan property, education loans, business-use property, qualifying REMIC interests)
result.condition: sum of listed qualifying asset categories is at least 60 percent of total assets
result.output: whether the asset-composition (60 percent) test is satisfied
